# Vendored: mitex 0.2.7

`mitex/` is the unmodified `@preview/mitex` Typst package, version 0.2.7, downloaded from
`https://packages.typst.org/preview/mitex-0.2.7.tar.gz` (md5 `f2d6ec28675218ce5fe8b225771552a`).
It converts LaTeX math into Typst markup that `typst-latex-renderer.ts` compiles.

It is vendored, not fetched through Typst's `@preview` package registry, so rendering needs no
network access and the version is pinned. To upgrade, download the new tarball from the same URL
with the target version and replace this directory; do not hand-edit its files.

Apache-2.0, see `mitex/LICENSE`.
